raw_response:
I have only 0.05 hectares here for my tubers, so buying chemical fertilizer makes no sense when a whole bag would be too much for this small plot. I will plant local cassava cuttings and manage the work myself with my children over about two weeks this season. We don't use sprays for root crops here, and the rains come regularly in the south, so there is no need for irrigation or hired help.
